lines.plain: Good morning, and welcome aboard! Your sentence begins on the way down.
Welcome aboard! Every floor you visit brings your freedom a little closer. Statistically.
Welcome back! Your debt to society has been calculated. Please don't ask to see it.
Good morning, crew! Today's descent is brought to you by the court's decision. Enjoy your stay.
Please keep your arms, legs and hopes inside the car. Going down shortly.
Doors opening! This floor used to be a hospital. It may still think it is.
Doors opening! Please collect your belongings, and anything else you find.
Doors opening! Remember, anything you record belongs to us. Anything that follows you is yours.
Here we are! Mind the gap, and the staff.
Doors opening! The lights on this floor are on for your comfort. Mostly.
The car is leaving now! Call any time. It usually comes.
We'll be just upstairs! Please enjoy the quiet.
Off we go! The car cannot wait on an occupied floor. You understand.
You're in good hands! Not ours.
The car is now leaving. Should you need us, press the button, and be patient.
Thank you for calling! Your car is on its way. Everyone on this floor now knows.
Your call is important to us! Please wait right there, exactly where you are.
Call received! Estimated arrival: soon. Estimated company: sooner.
Your car has been requested. Try to stay somewhere we can find you.
We heard you! So did the floor.
Your car has arrived! Please board promptly, and with everyone you came with.
Your car is here! We missed you.
Here we are! The doors are open. They will not stay that way.
Your car has arrived. Please count your crew. We already have.
All aboard! Walking is permitted. Running is understood.
Doors closing! Please stand on the side of your choice. Choose freely!
Doors closing! Anyone still outside will be welcomed back... eventually.
Doors closing! Red side goes down, yellow side goes home. No pressure!
Last call! The doors do not check who is in them.
Closing now! If you can hear this from the corridor, wave goodbye.
Going down! Deeper floors pay more, for reasons we have chosen not to explore.
Next stop, further down! Beneath the storage halls, you'll find more storage halls.
Going down! Each floor was built on top of the last. Nobody remembers what the first one was for.
Further down we go! The pay improves. The air does not.
Going down! Fun fact: this shaft is older than the building. All of the buildings.
Congratulations! Your findings have been banked, and your freedom is now slightly nearer.
Banked! At this rate you will be free in... we'll let you know.
Welcome back to the surface! Your earnings are safe. You may now go down again.
A member of your crew has been reassigned. Their sentence is complete!
One of your crew has been admitted. Visiting hours are over!
A crew member is no longer recording. Their equipment may be collected.
The staff have found one of you! Please continue working.
And that is everyone! Thank you for your service. A new crew will be along shortly.
That concludes today's descent! All sentences served. In a manner of speaking.
Nobody left to board. The car thanks you for your patience!
Nobody has ever finished their sentence.
It was a hospital before you came. It will be one after.
Thank you for travelling down with us! Have a wonderful floor.
Where were we? Ah yes. Enjoy your floor!
To bring your car faster, we are borrowing this floor's lights. Back in a moment!
Attention, crew. Lighting on this floor will be unavailable for a short while. Please move about freely!
The lights are going out now. It is nothing to worry about. You may wish to run.
And we're back! Your car is here. Do hurry.
Lights restored! Please make your way to the car. It is exactly where you left it.
Quota met! The call button is now at your service.
Quota met! Management is so proud of you. You may now call the car.
That is quota, everyone! Please call the car before anything else does.
Your car is on its way! One more round before we go!
Hide.
Coming, ready or not!
Found you!
Oh! It only wanted a hug.
Aww. Somebody made a friend.
Off to the party, then! Do save me a seat.
All done!
Forty.
Thirty.
Twenty.
Ten.
Nine.
Eight.
Seven.
Six.
Five.
Four.
Three.
Two.
One.
Instruments out, please. We pay for readings, not for sightseeing.
Your instrument is on E. It is why we keep you.
The needle is quiet because you are safe. We do not pay for safe.
Nothing recorded yet! Safe people record nothing. Do think about that.
That button works when the floor quota is met. Not before.
Call refused. The panel shows what this floor still owes us.
This floor is paid. Today is not. See the top corner.
One floor does not make a day. Today's number is on your screen.
Do not delay in boarding. Miss the car, and we keep your credits.
Board promptly. Credits are for people who are inside the car.
Somebody is not aboard! Their pay is about to become ours.
We are short one passenger. The doors will not ask twice.
One of you missed the car. Their credits stay with us.
A colleague stayed behind! They will wake in their cell, unpaid.
You missed the car. No pay today. You will wake in your cell.
The car left without you. So did your credits. See you at home.
The car cannot leave while anyone is aboard. Step off.
Still aboard? The floor quota will not meet itself.
Nothing records from inside the car. Nice try.
The car is safe. That is why it pays nothing.
The car is already here. It must leave before you call.
You cannot call a car you are holding. Empty it first.
Stand on BANK for home. Stand on DOWN to deserve it.
Two sides of the car. One goes home. One goes deeper. A tie goes deeper.
That side is locked until today's quota is met. Stand there if it helps.
BANK is locked. The monitor says how much you still owe.
Today's quota is on the monitor. Meet it, or you do not go home.
You owe us a day's work. The number is on the monitor. It is not negotiable.
If nobody comes back, nobody is paid, and we take an upgrade from each of you.
An empty car costs each of you an upgrade. The odds are on the monitor.
Two days lost. A third, and you start from nothing.
One more empty car and your records are wiped. No pressure!
Colleague down! Hold F beside them. They are on a timer.
A colleague is down. Hold F at their side before their time runs out.
You are down. A friend must hold F beside you.
Down already? Shout for someone who likes you. They hold F.
They return when the car next moves. Their tape is on the floor. Pick it up.
Gone until the car moves. Their tape is still worth money. Fetch it.
Out of breath already. Walking is free. Do budget accordingly.
You cannot sprint forever. Nothing down here needs to.
Drawers open if you hold F. What you find counts toward your day.
Go on, look inside. Hold F. Previous staff left quickly.
A previous crew left notes. The notes are true. The crew is gone.
Read it aloud to your colleagues. The last crew didn't.
Juice! Press G when your legs give out. One carton each.
A carton of juice. Press G when running stops working.
Read the signs. We are required to print your odds.
Everything here is posted in advance. Nobody can say we lied.
Every corridor here is the same corridor. Q leaves a mark.
Only your own arrows can be trusted here. Press Q to stick one.
Some furniture will hold a person. Get in gently.
Beds, cabinets, desks. You would fit. Slowly, though.
Hiding earns nothing. The quota is out there, with it.
Comfortable in there? We do not pay for furniture.
This floor is known to be... dangerous. Sneak, if you can.
Welcome to the Playroom! Quiet children last longest. Creep with Control.
It is getting cross. Whatever you are doing, do less.
That bar is its temper. You are filling it.
You have upset it! Hide, and get your instruments out. This part pays.
Now it is angry. Now it is worth recording. Instruments, please!
It is hunting now. I would not run.
No running while it looks. Running is how it finds you.
It remembers you now. Walking costs health. Creeping is free.
Note the new bar. Hurry, it empties. Creep, it forgives.
You have been seated! Press F for the horn. A friend may fetch you.
Enjoy the party. A colleague can hold F at the table to bring you back.
Listen. Something on this floor has started to move.
Something is up and about. You will hear it first.
New floor, new colleague. What kept you alive upstairs may not.
Please do not assume this one behaves like the last one.
You may recognise the staff here. Do not trust the uniform.
Familiar face? Faces are reassigned. Habits are reassigned separately.
Home! Spend at the windows, then bed. No more car tonight.
Windows one and two sell. Three and four improve you. Then you sleep.
The day ends when everyone sleeps. Hold F on a bunk.
Nobody leaves until everybody sleeps. Bunks are F. Off you go.
No rush! The car leaves when you do.
Take your time. The floor has plenty.
Still aboard? The doors will wait. Other things may not.
Nobody has returned from today. The court has helped itself to something of yours.
An empty car! We'll take that as a no. And we'll take one other thing.
Hello! And welcome to Continuance. This is Lidgate, our city. Everything is measured from here. Below Lidgate, there is nothing. Almost nothing.
This is you. You have been sentenced. Congratulations! This is your crew. Draw your own face. We insist. Each morning, the car takes you down.

Every floor has a resident. We do not know what they are. Point your instrument at it. Record what it does. Readings become credits. Credits keep the lights on upstairs. Each resident keeps one rule. We may not tell you what it is.
Meet the quota. Call the car. The car is not quiet. The floor will notice. Be aboard when the doors close. Please do not stay late. Staying late is... discouraged.
Then choose. Up, to bank your day. Or down, for more. Bank enough, and your sentence will end. Many crews are well on their way! Continuance. Leave it with us.
The vote was unanimous! It was also wrong. Going down.
I've counted your votes, and I've counted your credits. Only one of those was enough. Going down!
You've asked for up. I admire that. Going down!
The BANK side is working perfectly. So am I. Going down.
Democracy has been noted. The quota has not been met. One of these matters.
Home is for people who have paid for today. You are people who have not. Going down!
Up is a privilege. Privileges are listed on the board. Going down!
Lovely teamwork, everyone. Wrong direction, though. Going down, with enthusiasm!
Today is paid for! BANK is now open. So is DOWN.
Day quota met! You may go home. You may also be braver than that.
That's today's debt covered. Anything further is greed, and we encourage greed.
Time's up! Your crew has failed to reach quota in time. The Tenant will see you now.
Time's up! Your quota was met, well done. The Tenant is here all the same.
Today's complimentary offer: Squeaky Soles. Whoever takes it first wears them. Odds are on the back.
Today's offer: the Novelty Torch. The crew chooses who holds it. Odds are on the back.
Today's offer: a Second Opinion. The risk goes to whoever is hoarding flares. Odds are on the back.
Today's offer: Lights Out. Hazard pay may apply. Whoever takes it first takes the blame.
Today's offer: the Express. Fewer floors, more money. The crew chooses who answers for it.
Congratulations, %s. Hazard pay is now in effect.
Commiserations, %s. Your new shoes are very expressive.
%s has been issued a Novelty Torch. Please return it in working order.
A Second Opinion is available on the next floor. It may be used once.
Lights Out has been approved. Hazard pay applies to everything.
Lights Out has been approved. Hazard pay has not.
Express service confirmed. Please do not wave at the floor we skip.
Express service confirmed. The next floor has been told you are coming.
Offer declined. The company respects your caution and has noted it.
Feeling lucky? The offer may be doubled. Or not.
The car cannot be called without power. It will return when power is restored.
The call button is in another house. Do enjoy the neighbourhood.
Your lift has been called. Please wait where you are.
A colleague is currently on hold. Please cut them down at your convenience.
Welcome back, colleague. Your hold has ended.
The lift has departed. You are, of course, welcome to stay.
AHEM. THANK YOU. AS I WAS SAYING.
AHEM. THE COMPANY IS SPEAKING.
AHEM. THANK YOU, COLLEAGUES.
Doors open. The Tenant is expected in ten minutes. Do keep busy.
Welcome to the floor. You have ten minutes before the Tenant comes down. The company suggests you use them.
This floor allows ten minutes before the Tenant arrives. The clock started when the doors did.
Five minutes until the Tenant arrives. An excellent time to look productive.
The Tenant arrives in five minutes. Anything worth recording is worth recording now.
Five minutes remain before the Tenant. The company thanks you for your continued effort.
Two minutes until the Tenant arrives. Sensible crews are already thinking about the lift.
The Tenant arrives in two minutes. The company does not reimburse lateness.
Two minutes remain. Do wrap up whatever it is you are doing.
Tenant arrives in one minute. I'd hurry up if I were you.
One minute until the Tenant arrives. Consider this your final courtesy notice.
The Tenant arrives in one minute. The company wishes you a brisk walk to the lift.
